selected_activity:
Activity: Participatory Council Hearing: Competency Level 8.3.2
Approach: Students conduct a simulated community forum addressing 'Present information about the multicultural features of other countries.'. Teams take civic roles, debate feasible responses, and agree on a resolution using oral discussion or the available board and notebooks.
Student task: Prepare brief citizen statements, propose priorities, and vote on a community resolution. Standard class layout (40 students): Desks arranged into 8 teams (8 teams (8 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Teacher facilitation: Organizes all 40 students using 8 teams (8 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer. and monitors progress with outcome-focused prompts and time checks. Circulates across 8 teams, facilitating role execution and formatively checking progress.
Expected output: Approved 3-point citizen resolution sheet recorded in notebooks.
Grouping: 8 teams (8 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer.
